# John Nguyen

> Senior Software Engineer in Dallas–Fort Worth, TX, specializing in front-end systems, reusable web component libraries and accessible (WCAG) interfaces. 20+ years building for enterprise and agency clients including Allstate, Capital One and Mitsubishi Motors.

John Nguyen is open to select opportunities. This site is his portfolio; each project has a case-study page with screenshots, scope and stack. Client work: source and production links aren't public.

## Projects

- [Allstate](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/allstate/) (2018–Now, current): Enterprise front-end work for Allstate, including the Mesh library of reusable web components. Stack: Web Components, React, Angular, Unit Testing, WCAG.
- [Capital One Home Lending](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/capital-one-home-lending/) (2015–2018): Angular front ends for Capital One's Home Loans website and home equity application. Stack: Angular, JavaScript, Enterprise CMS, Unit Testing, WCAG.
- [BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/bcbs-tennessee/) (2012–2015): Client website build delivered at iCrossing. Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
- [Mitsubishi Motors Build and Price](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/mitsubishi-build-price/) (2012–2015): Vehicle configurator for building a Mitsubishi and seeing its price. Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
- [ThyssenKrupp Elevator](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/thyssenkrupp-elevator/) (2008–2012): Website and HTML email work delivered at Hawkeye. Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTML Email.
- [Hawkeye Agency Site](https://johnnguyen.net/projects/hawkeye-agency/) (2008–2012): Development of the agency's new website. Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
